scope: Prospective independent OpenMULTI3D1D O41 solve on the exact5750/4.5/A8.70 source atom/atmosphere of the held MULTI reference. Native EOS/background/rate interpolation and boundary differences must be measured. No background line blanketing in this first continuum-only control; no solar fit, physical parity/admission or replacement of Bride/source/production. Second prospective control requests actual disk-centre output and disables per-depth early freezing (convmax0) so all saved depth rates belong to the same final global iteration. The first run was a departure-only calculation with no output spectrum. The native pressure-graded/interpolated depth grid must be registered explicitly before comparing source-node populations. Prospective dense output-only control: canonical AIR-to-vacuum conversion once before native synthesis; no change to the SE frequency grid or physical inputs. Prospective output-only formal-solver linear control. SE controls/physics unchanged; require bit-identical saved O n/nStar to dense quadratic baseline before attributing differences to output transfer. Prospective Stark-off native control: pinned HOP interprets input gstk=0 as automatic Cowley estimate; current Bride interprets held gStark0 as no Stark broadening. This switch diagnoses that semantic difference, not an adopted physical model. Native populations may change; compare emergent output at original fixed populations only after measuring that change, no attribution of all effects solely to transfer. Prospective isolated accurate-kernel native control: original atom/state/EOS/boundaries/linear formal solver retained; only active non-H profile kernel switches from QLG-bot to existing fp64 reference with native fp32 inputs/output and frequency Jacobian. New native SE populations/rates and output are measured independently, not assumed equal. Original executable/default stays unchanged. Prospective VDW-off diagnostic, native disable_vdw=T at unchanged atmosphere/atom/EOS. Measures full SE response, not assumed identical. Tests remaining width sensitivity; no omission of physical VDW adopted.

physical_limitations: Native HOP EOS/continuous opacity and collision interpolation differ from Bride; explicit matched-input audit is required.
Line blanketing and background bound-bound opacity explicitly off in this first reference plan.
Output quadrature is explicit; none skips synthesis and disk_center requests vertical intensity, not flux or an abundance fit.
Source atom is not silently replaced by the supplied variant; source paths and hashes are checked.
